weechat_dir.description: The home directory for all WeeChat files (config, data, cache, runtime).

weechat_user.description: The system user running WeeChat, used for constructing default paths.

weechat_autoload.description: Enable auto-connect to servers when WeeChat is starting.

irc_nicks.description: List of nicknames to use for IRC connections.

irc_servers.description: List of IRC server configurations to connect to at startup.

irc_servers.items.description: Individual server configuration parameters. Note: items defines the structure of the list elements, not a top-level variable with type object in the schema root for this specific constraint interpretation, but to strictly follow 'items as a FLAT map field-name', we define the fields here.

irc_servers.items.name.description: Unique identifier for the server (used in config keys like irc.server.name).

irc_servers.items.address.description: Hostname or IP address of the IRC server.

irc_servers.items.port.description: Port number for the IRC server.

irc_servers.items.ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS connection for this server.

irc_servers.items.ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (if required).

irc_servers.items.channels.description: List of channels to join upon connecting to this server.

relay_enabled.description: Enable the relay plugin for external clients.

relay_port.description: Port number for the WeeChat relay.

relay_password.description: Password required to connect to the relay.

relay_protocol.description: Protocol used by the relay (weechat or irc).

logger_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

logger_buffer.description: Comma-separated list of buffers to log (empty for all).

logger_file_date.description: Date format string for log file names.

logger_file_size.description: Maximum size of a log file in megabytes before rotation.
